plugins.name: tool-histogram
plugins.description: /nerd opens a stats pane: tool usage bars, a text pie of tool share, tool-duration columns, token and per-turn trend charts.

plugins.name: nerd-theme
plugins.description: /skin switches the color scheme (cyan, amber, magenta, mono) shared by every nerd mod; also color-codes tool rows by status.

plugins.name: nerd-band
plugins.description: A quiet monospace stats row above the prompt: uptime, turns, tool calls, last turn time.

plugins.name: failure-log
plugins.description: /fails opens a pane collecting failed or denied tool calls so errors do not scroll away.

plugins.name: file-tracker
plugins.description: /files opens a pane listing every file Claude edited or wrote this session, with edit counts.
